Name: Forage Map Markers
Author: betterlch
Description:
[size=5][b]Forage Map Markers 采集物地图标记[/b][/size]
[line]
[b][size=4]Description 简介[/size][/b]

Marks today's forage, artifact spots, seed spots, ore pan spots, fish splash points and truffles with their own item sprites on the world map. Hover any marker for a per-area summary. Ore pan, fish splash and blessing butterfly markers are off by default, with config tooltips explaining their in-game lifetimes. Every forage item can be toggled individually in the config. Works with the vanilla map and NPC Map Locations.
用各自的物品贴图在世界地图上标记当天的采集物、远古斑点、种子斑点、淘盘亮点、鱼群气泡和松露，悬停任意标记即可查看该区域明细。淘盘亮点、鱼群气泡与祝福蝴蝶标记默认关闭，配置开关的悬浮提示说明了各自的存在机制。每种采集物都可以在配置中单独开关。兼容原版地图与 NPC Map Locations。

[b][size=4]Installation 安装[/size][/b]

[b]1.[/b] Install SMAPI
[b]2.[/b] Unzip and drop the ForageMapMarkers folder into your Mods directory (Vortex users can import the zip directly)
[b]3.[/b] Launch the game and open the world map (M). All options are configurable in GMCM; ore pan, fish splash & butterfly markers are off by default

/

[b]1.[/b] 安装 SMAPI；
[b]2.[/b] 解压 zip，将 ForageMapMarkers 文件夹放入 Mods 目录（Vortex 可直接导入）；
[b]3.[/b] 启动游戏按 M 打开世界地图，全部选项可在 GMCM 中配置（淘盘亮点、鱼群气泡、祝福蝴蝶默认关闭）。

[b][size=4]Main Features 主要功能[/size][/b]

• Forage / artifact spots / seed spots marked with their own item sprites (on by default)
• Truffles dug up by pigs are marked too, with their own filter toggle
• Per-item forage filter: a dedicated config page with an on/off toggle for every spawnable forage item (grouped by season / beach / mushrooms / desert & island / animals), plus an "extra hidden item IDs" field for forage added by other mods
• Ore pan spots (default off): no fixed timer - ~10% fade chance every 10 in-game minutes, always gone overnight
• Fish splash points (default off): a bobber next to the bubbles bites 4x sooner and counts as one tile deeper
• Fish frenzy: the marker becomes the frenzy fish itself, guaranteed catch nearby
• Blessing butterfly (default off): shows the day's location hint before the prismatic butterfly appears, then tracks its live position once you have entered that location
• Hover for "Area: item xN" (x1 stays silent); vanilla localized area names, built-in Chinese for untranslated ones
• Four highlight styles, marker size 12-40, colored type badges
• Festival grounds (Night Market, Desert Festival) only marked while their festival is on

/

• 内置简体中文。
• 采集物、远古斑点、种子斑点用各自物品贴图标记（默认开启）；
• 猪拱出的松露同样会被标记，并配有独立筛选开关；
• 逐采集物筛选：GMCM 独立子页，每种可生成的采集物一个开关（按季节 / 海滩 / 蘑菇 / 沙漠姜岛 / 动物分组），另有"额外隐藏的物品 ID"文本框可隐藏其他 mod 添加的采集物；
• 淘盘亮点（默认关）：无固定倒计时，每 10 分钟约 10% 概率消失，过夜必消失；
• 鱼群气泡（默认关）：气泡旁下竿咬钩快 4 倍、按深一格水计算；
• 鱼群狂热时标记变成狂热鱼本体，浮漂在旁每竿必出；
• 祝福蝴蝶（默认关）：彩虹蝶现身前提示当日所在地点，进入该地图后显示实时位置；
• 悬停显示"区域： 物品 xN"（单个不显示 xN），地名用原版本地化标签、未翻译处用自带简中；
• 四种醒目样式、标记大小 12-40、类型角标色点；
• 节日场地（夜市、沙漠节）仅节期标记。
